import torch
import torch_npu

def run(kv, gamma, cos, sin, index, k_cache, ckv_cache, k_rope_scale=None, c_kv_scale=None, k_rope_offset=None, c_kv_offset=None, epsilon=1e-5, cache_mode='Norm', is_output_kv=False):
    k_cache_out, ckv_cache_out, k_embed_out, y_out = torch_npu.npu_kv_rmsnorm_rope_cache(kv, gamma, cos, sin, index, k_cache, ckv_cache, k_rope_scale=k_rope_scale, c_kv_scale=c_kv_scale, k_rope_offset=k_rope_offset, c_kv_offset=c_kv_offset, epsilon=epsilon, cache_mode=cache_mode, is_output_kv=is_output_kv)
    return k_cache_out, ckv_cache_out
description: Fused KV RMSNorm + RoPE + cache update. torch_npu.npu_kv_rmsnorm_rope_cache(kv, gamma, cos, sin, index, k_cache, ckv_cache, ...) returns (k_cache, ckv_cache) for Norm mode. Supports multiple cache modes (Norm/PA/PA_BNSD/etc).
